title: Effect of SPS sintering temperature on the microstructure and mechanical properties of the WNbTaVTi refractory high entropy alloy
process_description: prepared by ball milling high-purity W, Nb, Ta, V and Ti powders for 24 hours with a ball-to-powder ratio of 5:1 at 300 rpm, followed by spark plasma sintering at different temperatures (1400°C, 1500°C, 1600°C) under 30 MPa pressure with a heating rate of 100°C/min to 1200°C, holding for 10 min, then heating to target temperature and holding for 5 min
